lines.text: You sent the Queen to the Ark?! What were you thinking?!

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: The Ark is the strongest faction here, after the Raptures.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It's got the highest chance of victory.
What about all the civilians?!

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Not a problem if the Ark kills her before she arrives.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: The Ark possesses a lot of mysterious technology that I don't know about.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'm sure they have something they can use.
And what if they don't?!

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You seem to have less faith in the Ark than I do, Human.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: They have something they can use. I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: In that sense, I trust the Ark.
We'll talk about this later.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Pinocchio, can you bring Whaley closer to the Queen?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: You want us to be right by her?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Hmm... Whaley says she doesn't want to.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: She says she can't help, so she doesn't want to get too close.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Then get as close as you can above her head.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll jump down and attack her with my drill.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And if it doesn't work?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I can't just sit here and do nothing.
Can't you call up another wave and redirect her?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: No, it's not something I can just whip up whenever I want.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: There's no sea nearby to draw water from, for one.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And more than anything, the Ark could end up getting submerged. Would you be okay with that?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: So we're on the same page, then.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hello, friends! Might I ask where we're headed?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Uncle! You're awake!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You bet! I told you, it was just a small injury.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: We're following that other friend right now.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Other friend?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Yeah. She's down below.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Ohhhh!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Who in the world is that?! That's the first time I've seen such a friend!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: I know, right? Isn't she incredible?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: My friends, will you take me to her?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'd love to speak with her!
Uh, I don't think now is the best time for that.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Why is that?
If things go wrong, she could devour everyone in the Ark.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: What do you mean? That friend—

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Excuse me.
Enikk!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I see you are aboard the White Mother Whale. I assumed that would be the case.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are you tracking the entity?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Enikk, the Queen... er, what we assume is the Queen is heading for the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Queen... Updating information.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I am aware of her approach. Do you have any means of interception?
Unfortunately, not at the moment.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood. Then the Ark will intercept her.
How?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: With a giant modified particle cannon.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Currently, it is the Ark's most powerful long-range weapon that is available for use.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: From the way the ground shifts with her movement, the provisional Queen's weight is estimated to be approximately one thousand tons.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is feasible that the particle cannon can destroy her.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: However, if she manages to survive due to unforeseen circumstances,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: we will leave it to you to deliver the finishing blow.
Okay...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Goodbye now.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: See? I told you.
I appreciate you trusting them.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Commander! Rapi!
Anis?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis!

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Look at me!

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Watch me shine!

Two hours earlier.
Tetra Line headquarters.
Pretty's room.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Are you sure you don't have to go?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: T.T. STAR's gotten dragged into a sordid affair at the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Hmm... If ma chérie Anis is there, it should be fine.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You really trust her, don't you?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: C'est un secret.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Oh, come now. Don't make me jealous.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I've never seen you play favorites like th—

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: President!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I didn't interrupt a romantic moment, did I?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Don't be ridiculous.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Anis, ma chérie. Did you terminé everything you needed to do at the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yes, I... phew...! It's been taken care of.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Superbe.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: President.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The expansive armament Star.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Give it to me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We need to stop that thing from getting to the Ark.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: So, le spectacle isn't over yet.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm going to become a star.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: That's the spirit, ma chérie.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You said there have always been stars on the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You were right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Even in this dark, trashy place, there are shining stars.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Stars that have continued to shine, no matter the circumstances.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I only saw the filth, but it turns out there was so much more light.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Light so bright that it completely drowns out the dark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I want those stars to look at me and find hope.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I want to be a star for them, for all the other stars.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Tetra Nikkes must always be someone people look to, even on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That is how...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: we give people hope.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I get it now. I finally understand. I know what that slogan means.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm going to be the star of the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: A star that gives people hope.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: EEEEEEEEEntertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Magnifique!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Yes, Anis, ma chérie! You have finally realized!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: The Ark is beyond saving? Non! There were always people shining bright!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It was the darkness and the dirt that made it so you couldn't see!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And now, you will become a véritable shining star! The star of stars!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: That is true entertainment!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: L'amour for humanity!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I will préparer the expansive armament Star!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Let us put on the greatest entertainment act

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: the Ark has ever seen!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Enikk. Are you listening?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Yes, I am.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: This monstre s'approche the Ark. How are you going to destroy it?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: I plan to use the giant particle cannon.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: In theory, it should  be able to intercept the target.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: And that will be la fin?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Correct. It has the highest probability of success of all the weapons currently available to us.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Let's make a deal, Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: What kind of deal?

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Anis will put on un spectacle and destroy le monstre.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: In exchange, you give me l'autorisation to personnalise the particle cannon.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh, vraiment?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Since the attack on the Ark, public concern has been on the rise.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: The recent incident with the E2 Crystals did not help,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: and we now have an unknown black spire approaching the Ark along with a string of earthquakes.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: We need something to put the citizens' minds at ease.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: If that takes the form of a flamboyant show, all the better.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Très bien.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: You're starting to comprendre l'esprit humain, Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Before we proceed with modifications, I will propose five possible upgrade plans.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text:
All of them can be finished within two hours. 
I will leave the choice to you.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Non.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Non, non, non!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Something so... tactical cannot possibly be entertaining!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Instead...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: I will transform the giant particle cannon into a stage!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: It will be called... the Star Stage!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Now, just head inside and get tested.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: The fitting adjustments could take as much as two hours.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You sure you're not gonna regret this?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: All this "star of stars" business.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: It means being absolutely flawless in front of others.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You could feel rotten inside, so tired that you could die, but you'll have to keep it hidden.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Everyone will look to you as a beacon of hope, and so you must only show them beauty.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: That's no easy feat.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What about Pretty?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Pretty...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Right. She did that.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: But in the end, her light shone too bright. It burned her up,

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: until only ashes remained.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Can I really do this?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Heh... Hm.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Don't do it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I've mulled it over. The reason Pretty was reduced to ashes was her fixation on being perfect.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So it's okay if you become a star with some rough edges.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: In times like these, being too perfect comes with its own set of problems.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Do as you like.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Just...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Don't burn yourself out.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Shine for as long as you can, and light up the Ark.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: If you can do that, it'll be more than enough.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay... I understand.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Now!
*Clap*
Mrs. Miss gently pats Anis on the back.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Come back prettier than ever,

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: and show them what you are:

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: the star of the Ark.
